title: SAU site profile (.sau/site.json)
description: One profile per site. It lives in the site's own (private) repository, at <dir>/.sau/site.json; every relative path in it resolves against <dir>, the directory that contains .sau/. The plugin never ships site data: briefs, outputs, forbidden terms and tracker data stay behind these pointers. See plugins/sau/docs/states-and-gates.md for how each field is used.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

schema_version.description: Profile format version. Added so running-sau can refuse or migrate a profile written for a later format instead of misreading it.

site.description: Short site id. Selects the profile when a repository holds several (`running-sau <site>`) and is written into estado.json.

domain.description: Production host without scheme, e.g. www.example.com. P4 checks the live page on https://<domain>.

locale.description: Primary market and language, e.g. es-ES. Every keyword and SERP call uses this country and language, never a US default.

alternate_locales.description: Other published languages of each page (e.g. ["en"]). Added because the sources publish ES and EN versions and P4 requests indexing for every language URL.

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code for the market (e.g. 2724 for Spain).

dataforseo.description: Optional. Added because the skills call DataForSEO and the sources pin the location code; when absent the skills derive country and language from `locale`.

brief.description: Path to the site brief (site-brief.md). Its markers [PRIVADO], [OBJETIVO], [HIPÓTESIS] and the incomplete-context warning are instructions for the agents. If the file is missing, running-sau offers site-brief-builder first.

output_dir.description: Directory for step outputs. Page mode: <output_dir>/<slug>/. Tanda mode: <output_dir>/tanda-<YYYY-MM-DD>/. Site-wide files (05-query-panel.csv, 05-history.csv) sit at its root. It must not be under a directory the site publishes (public/, src/).

code_repo.description: GitHub owner/name of the repository that receives the page code. Hooks recognise its checkouts and worktrees by their origin remote.

code_repo_path.description: Local checkout of code_repo, relative to the profile directory or absolute. Added because code and content can live in different repositories, and the orchestrator needs a checkout to branch from and to run `checks` in.

content_repo.description: GitHub owner/name of the repository that holds the profile, the brief and the outputs. Equal to code_repo for a single-repository site.

base_branch.description: Integration branch of both repositories. Work branches start here and pull requests target it (P3).

production_branch.description: Branch whose deployment is production (e.g. main or prod). Added because P4 is reached through a base_branch -> production_branch release, and the sources use different names per site.

branch_prefix.description: Prefix of every work branch: <branch_prefix><slug> in code_repo, <branch_prefix><site>-tanda-<date> for a tanda's outputs in content_repo.

git_author_email.description: Optional. Author email for SAU commits. Added because the sources require commits signed with one specific address so the deploy provider recognises them.

mode.description: Default unit of work. page: one page through the whole sequence. tanda: up to 5 seeds at once with one shared keyword run and a 00-reparto.csv. A run can override it.

motion.description: install-kit: step 2b may install motion-director's kit into the code (its installer). plan-only: step 2b writes the motion plan only; any code adaptation goes through a normal reviewed change. Step 2b itself runs only when requested at P1.

checks.description: Commands run in the code_repo checkout, in order, before P3 (e.g. npm run lint, npm run build). All must exit 0. They run locally because hosted CI may be unavailable.

scan_paths.description: Paths inside code_repo, relative to its root, where forbidden.sh inspects writes. Added because the code layout differs per site; the plan's default is src/.

existing_pages.description: Optional files in code_repo that list the site's current pages (route tables, SEO docs). Added because the tanda reparto must cross the seeds with existing pages to prevent cannibalisation.

content_dirs.description: Directories in code_repo where a seed's own content file may be created (the reparto's `archivo` must be inside one of them).

shared_files.description: Files in code_repo that several seeds touch (route tables, indexes). A seed may only append its own lines to them; conflicts keep the lines of both pages.

tanda.description: Optional, tanda mode only. Added because the tanda protocol confines each seed agent to its own content file plus append-only shared files, and these paths are site-specific.

forbidden_terms_file.description: Optional. Path to a plain-text file in the private repository: one term per line, case-insensitive, # starts a comment. forbidden.sh denies a write under scan_paths that contains any term. The terms are never copied into the plugin.

legal_review.description: blocking: P2 cannot be recorded without the reviewer's report for every page that requested it. informative: the report is attached when it exists and never blocks. off: no legal step. Whether a page requests a review is decided at P1.

legal_agent.description: Optional. Name of the subagent that writes the legal report (revision-legal*.md). Without it, running-sau asks the person for the report instead of dispatching an agent.

team.description: Team name. Added because labels and statuses belong to a team.

assignee.description: Name or email of the default assignee.

title_prefix.description: Prefix of every SAU task title (e.g. "SEO: "). Added because the sources fix a title convention.

linear.description: Optional. Where SAU proposes its tracker tasks. running-sau never creates or edits a task without the person's OK.

publish_notes.description: Reminders shown after every push to a branch with a preview, before P3 and at P4 (e.g. a manual step the deploy provider needs). Free text kept in the private profile.

close_notes.description: Reminders shown once when a page or tanda closes. Added so that site- or team-specific closing steps stay in the private profile instead of the plugin.

sar_register.description: Whether published changes are registered in SAR (the change-tracker skill). Added because one of the first sites is not yet covered by SAR: with false, running-sau skips that reminder.

request_indexing.description: Whether P4 includes asking the search engine to index every published URL (all locales) and recording the date. Added because the sources made it a fixed publish step on 2026-11-04.

onpage_min.description: Minimum onpage-optimizer score (out of 100) a page needs before P2 can be recorded.
